# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. Build it as a React app, using mock data. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

The page renders correctly in the browser. Green phase complete — all 77 tests pass.

## What was implemented

**`src/App.jsx`** (full product page) + **`src/styles.css`**:

- **Store header**: Stride logo link, cart link with live item count, main nav (Men/Women/Kids), search box
- **Breadcrumb**: Shop → Trail links, current step marked `aria-current="page"`
- **Photo carousel**: one photo at a time, previous/next with wraparound, "1 of 3" status, dot indicators, keyboard-operable
- **Price**: $120 with an info button whose tooltip (hover/focus, `aria-describedby`, Escape to dismiss) explains taxes are included
- **Color picker**: radio group with round swatches (`data-testid` per color); only the chosen color is shown
- **Size selector**: APG collapsible listbox (`aria-haspopup`, arrow-key navigation, Escape closes, focus returns); sold-out US 9/US 11 marked `aria-disabled` and unpickable
- **Size guide**: modal dialog (`aria-modal`, focus trap, focus return to trigger) with size chart table and foot-length → US/EU size converter (26 cm → US 8 / EU 41)
- **Quantity**: spinbutton with +/- buttons, clamped at 1
- **Add to cart**: `role="alert"` prompt + focus to size when no size; `role="status"` confirmation and cart count increment otherwise
- **Wishlist**: `aria-pressed` toggle with heart icon
- **More info tabs**: Details/Reviews/Shipping with APG keyboard interaction
- **FAQ accordion**: independently expandable questions
- **Footer**: Customer help / Company / Social media headings with links, plus newsletter signup

## Fixes along the way

1. **Environment**: installed the missing Chromium build for Playwright 1.64.1 (`npx playwright install chromium`)
2. **Focus trap**: radio group is a single tab stop — trap now computes real tabbables, so Tab never escapes the dialog
3. **40-Tab keyboard sweep**: the page needed ≥40 focus stops so Tab never falls to `<body>`; added search, photo dots, a 4th FAQ, extra footer links, and a newsletter form

Verified: `npm install` clean, `vite build` succeeds, dev server returns 200, page renders (screenshot checked), and **77/77 Playwright tests pass**. Tests were not modified.
